findings.title: Missing technical specification for PE-HD pipe
findings.message: The description "PE-HD Rohr DN 150 liefern" lacks material grade, wall thickness, and connection details required for a complete specification. According to VOB/C § 4.2.1, the contractor must provide all technical data necessary for construction.
findings.suggestion: Add material grade (e.g., PE-HD 0,5), wall thickness, and connection type (e.g., flared, compression) to the long text.

findings.title: Incomplete shaft description
findings.message: "Schacht DN 1000 herstellen" does not specify shaft dimensions, material, reinforcement, or depth. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires full technical details for such structural elements.
findings.suggestion: Include shaft diameter, depth, material (e.g., concrete C25/30), reinforcement details, and finish.

findings.title: Missing reinforcement and curing details for concrete
findings.message: The entry "Beton C25/30 einbauen" omits reinforcement type, spacing, and curing conditions. VOB/C § 4.2.1 mandates these details for concrete works.
findings.suggestion: Specify reinforcement (e.g., Ø12 mm bars, 150 mm spacing), concrete mix, and curing method.

findings.title: Unspecified masonry material and class
findings.message: "Mauerwerk KS 17,5 cm" lacks material type (e.g., brick, block), compressive strength class, and finish. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., clay brick), compressive strength (e.g., KS 17,5 cm), and finish (e.g., plastered).

findings.title: Missing finish and class for interior plaster
findings.message: "Innenputz herstellen" does not state plaster type, finish, or exposure class. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these specifications.
findings.suggestion: Specify plaster type (e.g., gypsum), finish (e.g., sanded), and exposure class (e.g., XC1).

findings.title: Incomplete concrete screed specification
findings.message: "Zementestrich CT-C25-F4" lacks mix proportions, compaction method, and curing time. VOB/C § 4.2.1 mandates full technical data.
findings.suggestion: Include mix proportions, compaction method (e.g., vibrating), and curing period.

findings.title: Missing insulation material and thermal properties
findings.message: "Wärmedämmung Boden" does not specify insulation type, thickness, or thermal conductivity. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for energy compliance.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., XPS), thickness (e.g., 100 mm), and thermal conductivity (e.g., 0,035 W/(m·K)).

findings.title: Insufficient detail for earth‑contact sealing
findings.message: "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile" lacks sealant type, exposure class, and thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these specifications.
findings.suggestion: Specify sealant (e.g., PMBC), exposure class (e.g., W1.2-E), and minimum thickness (e.g., 3 mm).

findings.title: Unspecified paving material and joint width
findings.message: "Pflasterdecke herstellen" does not state paving material, joint width, or compaction method. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., concrete pavers), joint width (e.g., 5 mm), and compaction method.

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer specifications
findings.message: "Asphalttragschicht einbauen" omits asphalt type, compaction, and thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 mandates these details.
findings.suggestion: Specify asphalt type (e.g., 60/70), compaction method, and thickness (e.g., 20 mm).

findings.title: Missing asphalt deck specifications
findings.message: "Asphaltdeckschicht einbauen" lacks asphalt type, compaction, and thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires full technical data.
findings.suggestion: Add asphalt type, compaction method, and thickness (e.g., 15 mm).
